concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it must run before any task that writes into the created directories (e.g., T004 download script, T005 CLI). The filesystem side‑effects create an implicit ordering dependency, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T004 is `[P]` yet it depends on the directories created by T001 and on the successful execution of the download script. Running it in parallel with T001 could fail, violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.
Task T005 is `[P]` but requires the CLI entry point to be available after the package initialization (T002) and after the dataset download (T004). Parallel execution could break the pipeline.
Task T006 is `[P]` yet it consumes the zip files produced by T004. It must be scheduled after T004; the `[P]` tag incorrectly suggests it can run concurrently.
Task T007 is `[P]` but writes `filtered_sequences.csv` which is consumed by Phase 3 tasks (T009‑T012). It must complete before those tasks; the parallel‑safe tag is inaccurate.
Task T009 is `[P]` but depends on the filtered dataset (`filtered_sequences.csv`) produced by T007. Parallel execution could cause missing input files.
Task T010 is `[P]` yet it requires utilities from T009 and the filtered dataset; ordering must enforce T009 before T010.
Task T011 is `[P]` but consumes pose estimates generated by T010; it must run after T010.
Task T012 is `[P]` and consumes pose estimates from T011; it must be ordered after T011.
Task T013 is `[P]` yet it requires the JSON output from T011. The `[P]` tag is unsafe.
Task T014 is `[P]` but depends on results from T013; ordering must be enforced.
Task T015 is `[P]` and depends on the synthetic‑control data generated in earlier analysis steps; it cannot safely run in parallel.
Task T016 is `[P]` and consumes the final CSV from T013‑T015; it must be scheduled after them.
Task T017 is `[P]` but assumes all code and documentation artifacts are present; it should run after the core implementation tasks.
Task T018 is `[P]` yet it logs memory profiling after a full pipeline run; it must be executed after the pipeline (Phase 5) completes.

Task T019 is `[P]` but modifies `utils.py`, which is used by earlier solver tasks (T009‑T012). Running it in parallel with those tasks would cause race conditions; it should be scheduled after Phase 3.
Task T020 is `[P]` but validates the total runtime of the full pipeline, which must occur after all prior phases have completed. The parallel‑safe tag is inaccurate.
